title: DEFONEOS — DHSC NHS AI Ethics Deep-Dive Pack
description: Sovereign AI governance for NHS AI ethics. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. UK-sovereign, audit-grade, NHS-compatible. EU AI Act Article 50 compliant.
text: DEFONEOS — DHSC NHS AI Ethics Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Article 50 DEFONEOS × DHSC / NHS NHS AI Ethics Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance for NHS artificial intelligence — clinical decision support, diagnostics, patient safety, and algorithmic fairness across England's £180B+ health service. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 3 Backbone Orgs 🏛️ 12 Entry Points NHS AI Lab NHS AI Lab / NHS England AI NHS England's centre of excellence for AI in healthcare. AI deployment governance framework. Regulated AI pathway (NICE/MHRA/HRA). AI Ethics Initiative. Regulation NICE Evidence Standards (AI) NICE Evidence Standards Framework for digital health and AI. Health technology assessment for AI-powered tools. Value-based pricing for AI diagnostics. Device Regulation MHRA AI Medical Devices MHRA regulation of AI/ML as medical devices (UKCA marking). Software and AI as a Medical Device (SaMD) pathway. Post-market surveillance for AI devices. Research Ethics HRA / Confidentiality Advisory Health Research Authority approval for AI research. Confidentiality Advisory Group (CAG) for patient data use in AI. Informed consent for AI-assisted care. Clinical Safety DCB0129/DCB0160 Compliance Clinical risk management standards for health IT. DCB0129 (manufacturer) and DCB0160 (deployer) compliance. Clinical Safety Officer (CSO) requirements. Data Governance NHS Digital / NHS England Data Unified Data Platform governance. NHS App data flows. Patient data opt-out (9RO). Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSPT) compliance. Primary Care GP Clinical Decision Support AI in primary care diagnostics. EMIS/SystmOne integration governance. Referral pathway AI. GP workload AI governance. Imaging AI Radiology & Pathology AI Radiology and pathology AI deployment. NHS AI Diagnostic Fund. Screening programme AI integration. AI-assisted reporting governance. Mental Health NHS Talking Therapies AI AI-assisted mental health assessment. Digital CBT tools governance. Suicide risk prediction ethics. IAPT outcome measurement AI. Ambulance/Emergency NHS 111/999 AI Triage AI-assisted triage governance. NHS 111 digital triage tools. Ambulance dispatch AI. Emergency department demand prediction. Workforce NHS Workforce AI Governance AI impact on NHS workforce planning. Rota/scheduling AI. Staff wellbeing monitoring. Clinical training AI tools. Parliamentary Health & Social Care Select Committee Parliamentary scrutiny of NHS AI. Health technology inquiry evidence. Patient safety accountability. DHSC ministerial oversight. ⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities 1. Clinical AI Safety Evidence Chain End-to-end audit trail for every NHS clinical AI tool. DCB0129/DCB0160 compliance evidence. Clinical risk management documentation. Incident reporting integration. 1.7M+ NHS staff affected. 2. Algorithmic Fairness & Bias Detection AI bias testing across NHS protected characteristics. Ethnicity bias in diagnostic AI. Socioeconomic bias in risk prediction. Health equity impact assessment. NHS EDI compliance. 3. Patient Consent & Transparency AI-assisted care consent governance. Patient-facing AI explainability. Right to human review of AI decisions. NHS Constitution AI transparency compliance. 4. Data Protection & Confidentiality UK GDPR compliance for NHS AI training data. Caldicott Principles application to AI. Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) for every NHS AI system. Patient opt-out (9RO) enforcement. 5. Regulatory Pathway Compliance NICE Evidence Standards alignment. MHRA UKCA marking for AI devices. HRA research ethics approval. Regulated AI pathway documentation. Post-market surveillance evidence. 6. Interoperability & Standards HL7 FHIR UK Core compliance for AI. SNOMED CT coding governance. NHS Spine integration audit.
